[Verse]
[Ab5]I'm like a cat in a cage,
locked up and [A#5]battered and bruised
[E5]I am the prodigal son,
a shameful prodigy too
[Ab5]I am the love of your life,
battering [A#5]ram and confused
[E5]I turn each day into night,
I stand there waiting for you
[Ab5]There is desire to fight,
but I have [A#5]nothing to prove
[E5]With the crowd and some lights,
I start to feel things move
[Ab5]Do you have something to hide?
'Cause I think [A#5]that we all do
[E5]I am a child inside,
back up and give me some room

[Chorus]
[B5]I'm just a bastard child,
don't let it go to your head
[E5]I'm just a waste of your time,
maybe I'm better off dead
[B5]You turn us loose in the night,
I'm fucking Jekyll and Hyde
[E5]We'll have the time of our lives
although we're dying inside
[Ab5]So let me go, go
So let me go, go
[E5]Just let me go, go
I'd rather go in alone
[B5]So let me go, go
So let me go, go
[E5]Just let me go, go
I'm never coming home

[Interlude]
[B5]
[C#5]
[Ab5]

[Verse 2]
[Ab5]Don't start to panic for me,
'cause I have [A#5]nothing to lose
[E5]I am as bright as the sun,
I burn up all that I choose
[Ab5]Upon the side of a field
I see a [A#5]city with lights
[E5]I touch her face and I kneel,
she tells me she's not alive
[Ab5]I am too nervous to run,
like kids who [A#5]scatter and hide
[E5]To reach and grab for someone,
but end up buried alive
[Ab5]A world is waiting for me,
a road that [A#5]I rarely use
[E5]I start to feel my feet,
they kick down walls as they move
